GlobalPolicy.source-of-truth: Verify the target chain media_asset -> collection/inbox -> immutable selection_snapshot -> analysis_run -> artifacts, plus channel_account/channel_surface recovery where channels render state.
GlobalPolicy.access-scope: The target product is single-user; verification must prove channel_account isolation, no accidental multi-user/workspace dependency, and no cross-channel mutation through stale callback or stale idempotency data. owner may appear only as deprecated compatibility wording.
GlobalPolicy.diagnostics-policy: Rejected and partially processed records must produce stable diagnostics instead of disappearing.
GlobalPolicy.retention-policy: Retention checks must prove metadata, stored object bodies, artifacts, diagnostics, and selection snapshots follow their separate lifecycle rules.
GlobalPolicy.coverage-policy: Coverage closure is reported per surface with the metric each tool can actually emit; missing metrics remain explicit gaps and do not collapse into a fake repo-wide 100% claim.
GlobalPolicy.target-coverage-policy: For the target rebuild, 100% means every declared table invariant, API operation, DTO compatibility rule, user flow, worker step, channel surface recovery path, and diagnostic failure mode has explicit automated or runtime proof.
GlobalPolicy.data-reset-policy: The current local database is disposable. Verification should prove clean schema reset/recreate, deterministic seed fixtures, and target behavior from fresh data; it must not require preserving or backfilling current local rows.
GlobalPolicy.redaction: Never assert on raw secrets, raw bot tokens, private object URLs, or full prompt payloads.

Schema tests fail if target public contracts expose old product route vocabulary, grouped-submission concepts, or non-deprecated compatibility names.
Enum tests cover media_asset, collection, selection_snapshot, analysis_run, analysis_run_step, artifact, and diagnostic statuses.

Diagnostic code tests cover ingestion rejection, channel-account mismatch, invalid selection snapshot, unavailable stored object, analysis prerequisite missing/failed/unavailable, worker failure, artifact expiry, retention denial, and adapter conflict.
Create media_asset from text, URL, and uploaded body with channel-account scope and stored_object/origin metadata.

Target migration and required schema fragments create channel_accounts, operation_requests, stored_objects, media_assets, selection_snapshots, analysis_run_steps, analysis_run_step_inputs, artifact_subjects, diagnostics, channel_surfaces, and channel surface event tables without recreating legacy sources, media_items, selections, selection_items, analysis_run_tasks, owner_type, owner_id, tenant_id, or safe_adapter_context.
Deterministic seed fixtures create a stable channel_account and inbox collection for fresh local reset/bootstrap tests.
Default inbox membership is created for accepted media_asset records.
Adding media to an existing inbox or user collection appends after the current highest active position without duplicate active positions.
Collection add, remove, reorder, archive, restore, and delete use version checks.
Selection snapshot remains unchanged after collection membership and media_asset metadata changes.
analysis_run creation requires a sealed selection_snapshot available to the caller.
analysis_run_step_inputs link steps to either selection_snapshot_items or prerequisite artifacts and enforce required/optional input semantics.
Artifact rows link to channel_account, stored_object, analysis_run, and artifact_subject lineage while enforcing retention status.
Diagnostics are persisted for invalid media, invalid selection snapshot, worker error, artifact error, and retention action.
Cross-channel-account reads and mutations fail for every table family.
Create and list media_asset records across supported input kinds.
Read inbox and user collections with pagination and diagnostics summary.
Create, mutate, archive, restore, and delete collections.
Create sealed selection_snapshots from ordered media_asset references and option snapshots.
Create analysis_run from selection_snapshot with idempotency behavior.

Create transcription, report, and deep_research runs with planned analysis_run_steps, declared step inputs, prerequisite transcription when needed, and visible prerequisite diagnostics when planning cannot proceed.
Poll analysis_run events and diagnostics.
Cancel analysis_run cooperatively, including queued terminal cancel, claimed cancel_requested, worker cancel-check visibility, and late worker finalization resolving as canceled.
Resolve artifact preview and download metadata through channel-account-scoped API access.
Query diagnostics by subject, severity, code, and correlation id.
Empty collection and paginated list results encode items as [] rather than null.
Worker claim loads declared analysis_run_step_inputs through internal control-plane contracts.
Agent-runner report and research steps consume ready transcript or prepared text-corpus artifact inputs and do not transcribe or discover raw speech media.
Worker artifact registration creates API-owned stored_object metadata and artifact_subject lineage for analysis_run plus analysis_run_step.
Missing transcript or text-corpus prerequisites produce diagnostics instead of silent failure or raw media processing in agent-runner.
Per-item and prerequisite diagnostics are recorded without mutating the selection snapshot.
Successful execution publishes artifacts under analysis_run.
Partial execution can finish as partially_succeeded when policy allows and diagnostics explain the skipped or failed items.
Worker cancellation records the phase where cancellation was observed.

Telegram.item: Accepted message, file, URL, photo, image, voice, audio, video, and document inputs create media_asset records through the target API and update channel-account inbox state.
Inline actions manage API-owned inbox or collection items, create selections, start analysis_run records, view diagnostics, and fetch artifacts.

Focused queued or running analysis_run cards expose cancellation through a run id and version checked callback, unfocused cards can cancel the latest visible active run, and background active runs do not block starting a new current selection.
Inbox visible items, remove actions, and clear-visible actions follow collection membership rather than the broad media inventory.
Status text and inline action labels are Russian-first and make refresh, collection actions, and run-specific result buttons self-explanatory.
Callbacks use API ids and versions and cannot mutate another channel-account state.
No user-facing execution mode is required to accumulate multiple items.

Web.item: Inbox, collection, selection builder, run list, run detail, artifact, diagnostics, and retention views use the same public API contract.
Collection edits after run creation do not change the run detail selection snapshot.
Normal Web UI labels use clear human wording for materials, groups, selection, progress, results, errors, and downloads instead of internal API vocabulary.

Internal terms such as media_asset, selection_snapshot, analysis_run_step, channel_surface, Run builder, Artifacts, Diagnostics, Run manifest, Analysis run, Media item, raw ids, and diagnostic internals appear only in explicit admin/debug contexts.

MCP.item: Tools create_media_asset, list_media_assets, search_media_assets, get_media_asset, delete_media_asset, create_selection_snapshot, get_selection_snapshot, run_analysis, get_run, list_artifacts, and get_diagnostics share API behavior with Web and Telegram while using target vocabulary and channel_account_id schemas.

required.item: Compose smoke ingests at least one file or URL, shows it in inbox, seals a selection_snapshot, creates analysis_run, publishes artifacts, and exposes diagnostics.
Runtime channel-account isolation check proves another caller cannot read the media_asset, selection_snapshot, run, artifact, or diagnostics.
Retention smoke expires or soft-deletes an artifact without corrupting selection or run history.

Gate.description: The from-scratch target architecture is fixed before implementation.
Gate.required-evidence: docs/architecture/single-user-channel-aware-target-architecture.md covers target vocabulary, table contracts, API operation groups, DTO/type names, app responsibilities, user flows, migration stages, and verification matrix; GRACE XML references that document.

Gate.description: GRACE docs define only final inbox-first architecture.
Gate.required-evidence: XML parsing succeeds for requirements, technology, development-plan, verification-plan, knowledge-graph, and operational-packets.

Gate.description: Stale public product vocabulary is isolated from active target contracts and normal UI copy.
Gate.required-evidence: Focused repository searches across the six GRACE XML files and Web visible copy show old names only in explicit deprecated, compatibility, migration, historical, or admin/debug contexts.

Gate.description: Public API and schemas match target vocabulary.
Gate.required-evidence: Contract tests validate target DTOs and fail on removed public product surfaces outside deprecated compatibility contracts.

Gate.description: Storage implements channel-account scope, immutable selection snapshots, step inputs, artifact lineage, lifecycle, retention, and diagnostics.
Gate.required-evidence: Focused storage tests pass for target schema fragments, target repositories, deterministic fixtures, live Postgres reset/recreate, operation_request replay, same-channel-account behavior, cross-channel-account cases, immutable selection snapshots, analysis_run events, artifact access, diagnostics, retention state, and channel_surface conflict/supersede/event behavior.

Gate.description: API provides the complete media_asset to artifact flow plus prerequisite orchestration.
Gate.required-evidence: Focused API tests pass for ingestion, inbox, collections, selection_snapshot, analysis_run, prerequisite planning, cancellation, artifacts, artifact_subjects, diagnostics, retention, validation errors, conflict mapping, empty arrays, pagination clamping, and media_asset idempotent replay.

Gate.description: Workers execute only through analysis_run_step contracts and immutable declared inputs.
Gate.required-evidence: Worker-common, transcription, and agent-runner tests pass for step_kind queue polling, step claim/progress/finalize, sealed selection_snapshot materialization, transcript/text-corpus artifact input materialization, diagnostics, and cancellation.

Gate.description: Telegram, Web, and MCP are thin adapters over shared API state.
Gate.required-evidence: Adapter tests prove shared state behavior and absence of separate durable adapter product state.

Gate.description: Executable coverage inventory reports the current per-surface baseline honestly.
Gate.required-evidence: `bash infra/scripts/coverage-inventory.sh` records statement, line, branch, or function coverage where supported, records pass/fail-only surfaces separately, and returns non-zero while any declared surface still has an unwired metric or failing probe.

Gate.description: Target coverage matrix and deterministic fixtures prepare the full proof wave.
Gate.required-evidence: docs/architecture/target-coverage-matrix.md maps source-plan tables, API operations, user flows, failure modes, compatibility rules, non-goals, app boundaries, and data reset rules to implementation proof, automated proof, QA proof, and remaining Beads; infra/fixtures/target/manifest.json and infra/scripts/target-reset-smoke.sh validate deterministic fixture and reset assumptions.

Compose proof captures target-only channel_account ingestion, inbox listing, selection_snapshot sealing, analysis_run execution, worker artifact publication, internal artifact download access, diagnostics query shape, channel-account denial, and history preservation after media_asset soft delete.

FailureTaxonomy.failure: Input is unsupported, unreadable, too large, unsafe, or missing required metadata.
Caller attempts to read or mutate another channel account resource.
Mutable collection operation used a stale version.
Selection snapshot references unavailable, deleted, quarantined, or cross-channel-account media_asset records.
analysis_run creation was attempted from an unsealed selection_snapshot.
Run cannot access a required stored object because retention, deletion, or remote resolution removed it.
A later step needs a transcript or text-corpus artifact that does not exist yet.
A prerequisite transcription or text preparation step failed.
A prerequisite cannot be scheduled because the input kind, retention state, or provider contract makes it unavailable.
Internal execution failed and produced diagnostic context.
Artifact is failed, expired, deleted, or not yet published.
Retention action violates audit, channel-account access, or lifecycle rules.
